Official document (PDF) · Draft S/4538 · Meeting record S/PV.907

158 (1960). Resolution of 28 September 1960 [S/4543]

The Security Council,

Having examined the application of the Republic of Senegal ,33 Recommends to the General Assembly that the Republic of Senegal be admitted to membership in the United Nations.

Adopted unanimously at the 907th meeting.

33 Ibid., document S/4530.
